groups.line: Five novels over eight hundred years. Hard science fiction in the strictest sense: every law of physics is obeyed as currently understood. The titles follow the story outline and are not final.

technical.title: Orbital Ring Engineering
technical.description: Mass transit to space: orbital ring, mass driver, and space elevator engineering. Volume I, the complete design review, is the one to read first.

volumes.title: Space Mass Transit Complete Design Review
volumes.headline: Orbital rings? Mass drivers? Space elevators? This book has the numbers.
volumes.description: Volume I is the complete design review, and the volume to read first. It takes the ring as a whole, at one altitude, with one cable, one bearing, one set of motors and one power system, and asks whether it all works together. The answer is mostly yes, with the caveats stated, and the open questions are listed for the team that eventually builds the ring. Volumes II and III carry the derivations behind the numbers: the first principles, and the launch technologies.

volumes.title: First Principles: Orbital Mechanics, Materials Science, and Electrical Systems

technical.title: Megawatt-Class Ion Propulsion
